observations: Two 30-minute jobs both at zero reported 30 minutes overlap and no valid finish for one person.
One after the other set job B to 30–60, zero overlap and finish 60.
Moving B to 70–100 kept zero overlap and changed finish to 100; screenshot aligned both bars correctly.
Reveal said the Minute 60 prediction held beside the final minute 100 result, then explained shared capacity.

complexity.conceptualDemand: Distinguish calendar layout from available capacity.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Two test buttons and a slider.

whyCool: A calendar can draw parallel work without providing parallel capacity.
caveat: Prediction feedback does not explain why an original 60-minute answer still holds after changing the final finish to 100.
effort: Prediction, conflicting test, serial preset, later-start boundary, screenshot and reveal.
bucketReason: Useful accurate timeline with ambiguous prediction verdict.

prediction.reason: The intended arithmetic choice is clear, but the initial simultaneous plan has no valid finish.
prediction.evidence: Options 30 and 60 despite the tested initial plan being infeasible.

interaction.reason: Preset and slider distinguish infeasibility, earliest serial completion and idle delay.

payoff.reason: Correct shared-capacity explanation is weakened by unconditional prediction feedback.
payoff.evidence: Prediction held beside final finish 100 after choosing 60.

clarity.reason: The timeline is clear but verdict context is ambiguous.
clarity.evidence: Final outcome differs from selected prediction.

transfer.reason: States a useful principle without a concrete second application.
transfer.evidence: Separate calendar rows do not create capacity.

surprise.evidence: Initial plan has no valid finish.

visualExplanation.reason: Timeline accurately displays start, duration and idle space.

practicalValue.evidence: One person cannot perform both jobs concurrently.

depth.evidence: Zero overlap can finish at 60 or 100.
